name: AutomationDirect T30030-2SR fuse-system component
summary: T30030-2SR fuse-system component arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: T30030-2SR is the drawing identifier for fuse-system component in AutomationDirect's Edison Class T Fuses collection. A fuse-system component forms part of a selected overcurrent protection arrangement. The fuse link, holder and surrounding terminals may have different mechanical drawings and replacement needs.

For example, in a control-power panel with a separately selected fuse arrangement, use the T30030-2SR reference to coordinate conductor terminals, replacement route and accessible device identification. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Power Products/Edison Class T Fuses/T30030-2SR.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep conductor terminals, replacement route and accessible device identification visible in the layout.
